need.capability: User authentication with support for email/password, eventual Google SSO, and multi-tenant role-based access control (admin, driver, dispatcher)
need.business_context: Two-person bootstrapped B2B SaaS startup for small logistics companies, currently pre-revenue with four months of runway
need.problem: No existing authentication system in place and need to implement a basic, secure auth flow quickly without building a complex system from scratch

intent.rationale: User authentication is a foundational platform requirement and not part of the startup's unique logistics or route-planning IP

resources.budget_note: Very tight budget, ideally under $50/month to start with a strong preference for a free tier
resources.runway_note: Approximately 4 months of runway remaining, with 2 weeks of engineering time budgeted for this task

soft_steer: Speed of deployment, low cost, and ease of setup are prioritized over custom-built control or complex self-hosted infrastructure
